Container.Name: plex-bridge
Container.Overview: Play Plex music on WiiM players. Linux x86-64 beta; independent Unraid acceptance pending. Enter this server's reserved LAN IPv4 and a private 32–256 character setup code from your password manager. After starting, open WebUI. Ports 8793–8795 must be free. Data lives in the Docker named volume plex-bridge-data, NOT appdata: include it in stopped backups before replacing Docker storage. See the project quick-start for backup and reviewed updates. One active Plex queue; trusted LAN only.

Config.Name: Server LAN address
Config.Description: This Unraid server's reserved IPv4 address, for example 192.168.1.10. No http:// or port.

Config.Name: Private setup code
Config.Description: Generate 32–256 characters in your password manager; no spaces. Enter the same code on the first WebUI screen. Keep it private. Used only on first launch.
